title: Data Strategy & Analytics Specialist - Basel - Solid Oncology
desc: At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche. This role is based in the Real-World & Clinical Data Strategy (RWCDS) team which drives data excellence and analytics to power enhanced decision-making and evidence-generation within Roche Product Development. We develop and implement data strategies that unlock the value of clinical, operational, and real-world data to accelerate evidence generation, decision-making, and innovation across PD and beyond. By embedding FAIR principles, advancing data governance, and enabling data productization, RWCDS ensures that data is not only findable and usable, but also a driver of scientific rigor, regulatory readiness, and AI-powered transformation. Through deep partnerships with internal functions and external collaborators, we shape a future-ready data ecosystem that supports personalized healthcare and efficient drug development. The Opportunity: The Data Strategy & Analytics Specialist contributes to the design and execution of data strategies and analyses that enable decision-making and insight generation across a therapeutic area or molecule portfolio. Working under the Data Strategy & Analytics Lead, you will partner with cross-functional teams—translating scientific protocols into robust analytical code, cohort extractions, and reproducible pipelines using multi-modal real-world data and clinical assets. You will also contribute to the translation of scientific and business needs into analytical frameworks and data-driven solutions. This role demands strong core data science skills, analytical execution, and a growth mindset to continuously elevate team standards. You execute data transformations, cohort extractions, and descriptive/observational analyses leveraging real-world (EHR, Claims, etc.), clinical trial data for secondary use, and operational multi-modal domains You translate analytical or study requirements into cohort definitions, derived variables, and analysis-ready datasets. You follow state-of-the-art coding best practices, version control, unit testing, and structured QC routines to guarantee fully reproducible analytical pipelines. You summarize and visualize exploratory analytical outputs, cohort characteristics, and study results to communicate findings effectively to project teams. You partner seamlessly with RWD Scientists and cross-functional study leads during study framing and protocol development, providing active feedback on data availability, feasibility, methodology, and execution. You actively contribute well-documented code snippets, analytical templates, and learnings to the internal team repository. You assist in identifying fit-for-purpose real-world data (RWD) sources, performing data quality evaluations, terminology mappings, and schema transformations for secondary data use. You partner with study teams and central data engineering functions to gather analysis requirements, specify derived variables (e.g., ADaM, ARDs), and shape clinical trial data marts for secondary use. You collaborate with central data engineering and governance teams to guide multi-modal data integration, applying common data models (OMOP, CDISC) and structured mappings across clinical trial and real-world assets. You collaborate with internal partners to analyze data structures, document data lineage, and maintain structured, compliant, and accessible data assets to support long-term data strategy and reusability. You safely leverage modern AI coding tools and LLM assistants (e.g., Claude Code, Copilot) to accelerate scripting, query building, and data extraction while maintaining scientific rigor and code quality. Who you are: You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Life Sciences, Computer Science, Epidemiology, Biostatistics, Public Health, Health Economics (HEOR), or a closely related quantitative field You have 2+ years of experience working with structured data in a research or healthcare setting (please note: internships and any study-related placements/practical experience are excluded). You have solid working knowledge of R or Python, as well as SQL You understand data dictionaries, mappings, or metadata tagging You are familiar with data systems used in clinical or operational settings You demonstrate capacity for independent thinking and ability to make decisions based upon sound principles You exhibit excellent strategic agility including problem-solving and critical thinking skills, and agility that extends beyond the technical domain You demonstrate respect for cultural differences when interacting with colleagues in the global workplace You possess excellent verbal and written communication skills, specifically in the areas of presentation and writing, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts in clear language Preferred Qualifications: Working knowledge of descriptive statistical methods and epidemiological concepts used in observational healthcare research (e.g., cohort identification, censoring, time-to-event concepts). Prior experience in Oncology. Familiarity with clinical terminologies and coding systems, including ICD, SNOMED CT, RxNorm, CPT, and HCPCS. Exposure to real-world data common data models (e.g., OMOP CDM) or CDISC standards (SDTM, ADaM). Familiarity with software engineering best practices (Git, unit testing) and AI-assisted coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot). This position is based in Basel and relocation assistance is not available. Ready to make your next big move? If this sounds like the perfect fit for you, we’d love to chat! Send us your CV and a cover letter telling us why you’re excited about this role, and apply today! #PDDT #PDDBasel Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche

title: Safety & Security Data Analyst ( UAE National )
desc: About The Job Your Impact: As a Safety & Security Data Analyst, you will transform operational and documentary data into clear insights that strengthen decision-making and help protect our people, boutiques, assets and brand across the UAE. Working closely with the Head of Safety & Security and key business stakeholders, you will build datasets, identify emerging patterns, improve operational consistency and support a more proactive, evidence-based approach to safety and security management. This role combines analytical rigour with practical business understanding. You will work cross-functionally with Finance, Store Planning and external partners to organize complex information into archives, dashboards, management reports and actionable recommendations suited to a dynamic luxury retail environment. Your Main Responsibilities: · Collect, consolidate and analyse safety and security data from boutiques, incidents, investigations, electronic logs and other relevant sources. · Identify trends, recurring issues, risk indicators and anomalies, translating findings into practical recommendations. · Develop, maintain and continuously improve dashboards, datasets and key performance indicators for safety, security, compliance and service delivery. · Prepare accurate and concise weekly, monthly and quarterly reports, highlighting key developments, performance gaps and recommended actions. · Create clear visualisations and presentations that make complex data understandable for both technical and non-technical audiences. · Perform data validation, reconciliation and quality checks, following up on missing, inconsistent or incomplete information. · Support the standardisation of incident categories, reporting fields, definitions and data collection methods across locations. · Handle sensitive information with a high level of confidentiality, integrity and appropriate access control Your Energizers: · Turning complex or fragmented information into clear, useful insights. · Using data to anticipate risks and support better operational decisions. · Building dashboards and reports that are trusted, practical and easy to use. · Combining attention to detail with curiosity, critical thinking and continuous improvement. · Seeing your analysis contribute directly to the protection of people, assets, operations and brand reputation. What You Can Bring: · Strong analytical thinking, intellectual curiosity and the ability to identify meaningful patterns in complex datasets. · High ethical standards, professional integrity and discretion when handling sensitive information. · Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and practical experience with Microsoft Power BI · Ability to produce concise management reports and presentations using PowerPoint and other Microsoft Office tools. · Strong organisational skills, attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities and recurring deadlines. Requirements: · UAE National (Emirati with Family Book). · University degree in Statistics, Business Administration, Risk Management, Political Science · Relevant experience in data analysis, business intelligence, reporting or performance management; exposure to safety, security, risk, compliance, retail or another operational environment is preferred. · Demonstrated experience creating dashboards, analysing operational data and presenting findings to stakeholders. · Ability to work independently, maintain accuracy under time pressure and collaborate effectively across functions.

title: Research Associate 1
desc: Position Overview: We are seeking a highly motivated and skilled Research Associate I to join our dynamic team in the sample management. In this role, you will be responsible for the management of biological samples, ensuring their integrity, overseeing quality control, and supporting research projects that rely on biological specimens. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in bio sample management, research methodologies, and data analysis, with an interest in contributing to cutting-edge scientific research. Key Responsibilities: Sample Collection and Processing : Oversee the collection, preparation, and processing of biological samples (e.g., blood, tissue, saliva, DNA) in accordance with established protocols and best practices. Maintain proper documentation and labeling of samples, ensuring traceability from collection to storage. Sample Storage and Management : Ensure proper storage conditions (e.g., temperature, humidity) for various types of biological samples, including cryopreservation and ambient storage. Implement inventory management procedures to track and organize samples, utilizing database systems and laboratory management software (e.g., FreezerPro, LabArchives). Ensure the samples are appropriately cataloged and accessible to researchers in a timely manner. Database Management and Data Analysis : Manage and update the sample database, ensuring accuracy and compliance with sample tracking and research needs. Assist in data analysis and reporting, including the creation of sample inventory reports and performance metrics. Collaborate with the research team to retrieve and prepare data for research publications or grant proposals. Regulatory Compliance and Quality Control : Monitor and ensure compliance with regulatory requirements, including HIPAA, IRB guidelines, and biorepository-specific SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures). Implement quality control procedures to ensure sample integrity and that all processes meet accreditation standards (e.g., CAP, ISO, CLIA). Assist in preparing for audits and inspections, ensuring documentation and records are up to date. Collaboration with Researchers : Work closely with internal and external research teams to understand sample requirements, providing expert guidance on sample availability, quality, and suitable use. Support researchers by preparing and distributing biological samples for experiments and studies. Provide expertise in biorepository protocols, best practices for sample handling, and troubleshooting of issues related to sample collection or storage. Research Support : Assist in the design and execution of research projects involving the biorepository’s sample collection and management processes. Contribute to scientific publications, presentations, and other research outputs, providing data and insights from biorepository-managed samples. Continuous Improvement and Training : Proactively identify areas for process improvement in sample management and recommend strategies to enhance operational efficiency. Stay current with advancements in biorepository management, biosample storage technology, and related regulatory guidelines. Mentor and train junior staff or technicians on best practices in sample handling and database management. Qualifications: Education : Bachelor’s degree in Biological Sciences, Biotechnology, Molecular Biology, or a related field (preferred). Experience : 0-2 years of experience in a laboratory or biorepository setting, with a focus on sample management, biospecimen processing, and quality assurance. Familiarity with biorepository software and data management tools (e.g., FreezerPro, LabArchives, LabWare, snowflake based database, LIMS,  is highly desirable. Skills : Strong understanding of biological sample management, including tissue processing, cryopreservation, DNA/RNA extraction, and cell culture. Knowledge of regulatory compliance (HIPAA, GxP, CLIA, IRB). Proficiency in data analysis and database management (e.g., Excel, SPSS, R). Excellent organizational skills with keen attention to detail and accuracy. Ability to troubleshoot technical issues and provide practical solutions. Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with researchers and other staff. Experience with laboratory equipment (e.g., freezers, liquid nitrogen tanks, centrifuges) and ensuring proper calibration and maintenance. Experience in SQL, Python Plus. Working Conditions: This position involves working in a controlled laboratory environment with exposure to biological samples, chemicals, and laboratory equipment. Candidates must adhere to strict biosafety protocols and wear appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) as required. An occasional evening, weekend, or holiday hours may be necessary depending on project    The pay range is listed and actual compensation packages are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years & depth of experience, certifications and specific office location. This may differ in other locations due to cost of labor considerations. Remote USA $23 — $25 USD OUR OPPORTUNITY Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives. The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you’ll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, you’ll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management. WHAT WE OFFER Competitive Benefits - Employee benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and disability plans for eligible employees and their dependents. Additionally, Natera employees and their immediate families receive free testing in addition to fertility care benefits. Other benefits include pregnancy and baby bonding leave, 401k benefits, commuter benefits and much more. We also offer a generous employee referral program! title: Junior Commercial Insights Analyst
desc:
Our Company
At Quantum, we connect global brands with high-intent consumers. We turn intent into action and complexity into clarity.



Our Mission is clear, to help smarter, faster buying decisions. Our vision, to be the world’s most used digital comparison service, delivering value and simplicity to millions.



We drive growth through data-driven affiliate marketing built for performance from day one. Every campaign is measurable, optimised in real time, and designed to scale.



With in-house tech, full-stack analytics, and a compliance-first mindset, we give our partners an edge. We drive confident decisions and growth in regulated and high-growth sectors. We’ve helped ambitious brands grow faster, smarter, and globally.



The role

Our Commercial Insights team is growing! We're looking for a Junior Commercial Insights Analyst to join our team in London.

In this role you'll own real analysis from day one, turning data from across the business into reporting and recommendations that commercial, marketing, and product teams rely on.

Key responsibilities

 - Partner directly with marketing, product, and commercial teams to scope analytical work - you define the brief as much as you respond to it

 - Use data visualisation tools such as Build and maintain reports and dashboards in Tableau, Power BI and Looker with guidance from senior analysts

About you

title: Stage 2027 - Data Scientist  Modélisation des risques indus sur la production d’avions (All Gender)
desc: Job Description: Et si votre aventure professionnelle commençait avec Airbus Protect ! Vous recherchez un stage de fin d’étude ou intégré dans une année de césure vous permettant de valider votre diplôme ? Nous vous proposons de travailler auprès d’ experts en analyse et maîtrise des risques dans les métiers de la cybersecurity, de la safety et de la sustainability . Une offre de stage intitulée « Stage 2027 - Data Scientist - Modélisation des risques industriels sur la production d’avions (All Gender) » vient de s'ouvrir au sein d’ Airbus Protect sur son site de Toulouse . Vous rejoindrez le département Cybersecurity en charge de modéliser la production à l’échelle d’une famille d’avions Airbus pour l’évaluation des risques opérationnels. La data science est un levier stratégique majeur pour Airbus Protect. Face à la complexité des enjeux de production d’avions, il est essentiel d'évoluer d'une simple analyse descriptive vers une modélisation prédictive, rigoureuse et défendable, des risques industriels et opérationnels. Cette approche permet d'éclairer la prise de décision, de sécuriser la chaîne d'assemblage et d'optimiser la résilience globale de l’entreprise. Au sein de l'équipe SIONA, en collaboration directe avec les équipes opérationnelles et le planning, vous aurez pour mission de développer un modèle innovant traduisant les risques de la chaîne de production de cette famille d’avions, puis de participer à la création d'un tableau de bord clair et décisionnel à destination du top management. Tâches et responsabilités Votre stage s'articulera autour de deux axes complémentaires mais essentiels pour construire un modèle robuste et crédible. Votre tuteur/tutrice vous aidera à identifier vos objectifs professionnels et vous accompagnera dans le développement de vos compétences. Vos principales activités seront les suivantes : Axe 1 : Analyse de l'existant, benchmark et recherche méthodologique L'objectif est d'explorer de nouvelles approches scientifiques pour faire évoluer la modélisation des risques industriels. Phase d'état de l'art et diagnostic : Analyser les modèles prédictifs actuellement déployés au sein de l'équipe SIONA pour identifier leurs limites et leurs leviers d'amélioration. Réaliser une veille scientifique et méthodologique sur la modélisation probabiliste et stochastique appliquée aux chaînes de production complexes. Phase de cadrage et propositions : Évaluer la pertinence, la faisabilité et la scalabilité des nouvelles méthodes identifiées au regard des contraintes de la ligne d'assemblage. Proposer des architectures de modélisation innovantes permettant de mieux capturer la propagation des aléas industriels. Axe 2 : Développement, expérimentation et intégration du modèle L'objectif est de concrétiser les apports de la recherche à travers un prototype fonctionnel et exploitable par la direction. Phase de prototypage et entraînement : - Structurer et prétraiter les données de production (planning, retards, goulets d'étranglement, contraintes de ressources). - Développer et tester le nouveau modèle prédictif en Python pour simuler les scénarios de risque sur la chaîne d’assemblage final (FAL). - Réaliser des analyses de sensibilité et valider la précision des prédictions par rapport aux données historiques. Phase de déploiement et valorisation : - Intégrer le modèle validé sur la plateforme de data science interne d'Airbus Protect. - Participer à la restitution des résultats sous forme de tableau de bord décisionnel , clair et synthétique, destiné au top management. Phase de restitution et transmission de connaissances : - Synthétiser les retours d'expérience et les résultats de la recherche sous forme de documentation méthodologique et pédagogique. - Transmettre les nouvelles méthodologies validées aux équipes d'Airbus Protect afin d'enrichir le catalogue de compétences internes et de réutiliser ces approches sur d'autres projets industriels. Idéalement, ce stage d’une durée de 6 mois commencera de préférence en janvier (la période est communiquée à titre indicatif, et pourra être revue). Ce poste nécessite une habilitation de sécurité ou nécessite d'être éligible à une habilitation par les autorités reconnues. Ce stage vous permettra notamment de développer les compétences suivantes : L'opportunité de travailler sur un projet stratégique, de la définition du besoin à l'implémentation d'une solution concrète. Une expérience unique à l'intersection de la data science, de la finance et d'un domaine de pointe, la cybersécurité. Une forte visibilité au sein d'équipes stratégiques d'un leader mondial de l'aéronautique. Cette offre vous intéresse ? Êtes-vous notre candidat·e ? Vous préparez actuellement un diplôme de niveau Bac +5 (ou équivalent) dans une école d'ingénieur, Master 2 en Data Science, Mathématiques Appliquées, Statistiques ou une discipline apparentée ? Durant vos études et expériences précédentes, vous avez développé les compétences suivantes : Indispensable : Maîtrise de la programmation en Python et des librairies de data science (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn). Solides connaissances en modélisation statistique, probabilités et machine learning. Une première expérience avec des bases de données (SQL) est un plus. Une connaissance de l’aéronautique, notamment pour sa partie industrielle, ou une appétence pour le secteur serait un plus. Une connaissance de la gestion des risques notamment liés à la cybersécurité est appréciée également Soft Skills Rigueur et excellent esprit d'analyse. Autonomie , proactivité et curiosité intellectuelle. Très bon relationnel et capacité à communiquer avec des interlocuteurs aux profils variés (techniques et financiers). Capacité à synthétiser et à restituer des informations complexes. Compétences linguistiques attendues : Anglais : Avancé Français : Courant Prochaines étapes de notre processus de sélection: Votre candidature sera analysée par un manager et un recruitment business partner dans les prochains jours. Si votre profil correspond aux pré requis, vous serez invité·e à réaliser un entretien technique et un entretien RH. title: Quantitative Analytics Professional
desc: At Freddie Mac, our mission of Making Home Possible is what motivates us, and it’s at the core of everything we do. Since our charter in 1970, we have made home possible for more than 90 million families across the country. Join an organization where your work contributes to a greater purpose. Position Overview Freddie Mac’s Single-Family Modeling team is seeking a Quantitative Analytics Professional to develop and enhance collateral models using state-of-the-art statistical methods, machine learning, and data technologies. Your work will inform daily decisions about mortgage collateral and support effective risk management across Freddie Mac’s portfolio. You will collaborate with modeling teams and business partners to research, prototype, develop, and validate models using large-scale structured and unstructured data. You will apply distributed computing, advanced machine learning, and emerging AI—including GenAI where appropriate—to improve collateral models and modernize modeling workflows, with a focus on business value, reproducibility, and strong governance. Our Impact Freddie Mac is leading the U.S. housing market forward by making homeownership and rental housing more accessible and affordable. Our team develops robust, scalable models that support the Single-Family business by enabling critical, data-driven risk decisions. Your Impact Collateral Modeling and Research: Develop and validate analytical methods and models to assess collateral risk for new and existing financial and mortgage products. Research enhancements to existing models, conduct experiments, develop prototypes, and apply industry best practices to address business needs. Advanced Technology Application: Evaluate and apply emerging statistical, machine learning, and AI technologies—including GenAI where appropriate—to improve collateral models and modeling workflows, consistent with business objectives, regulatory requirements, and enterprise risk management frameworks. Model Development Practices: Apply effective tools and practices for model development, version control, and reproducibility. Improve consistency, transparency, and quality across modeling teams. Data and Computing: Use distributed computing and data-processing technologies to analyze large-scale structured and unstructured datasets and modernize end-to-end model pipelines. Independent Problem-Solving and Business Support: Independently develop practical solutions to complex modeling problems under limited direction. Provide analytical support and day-to-day technical expertise to business and product partners. Collaboration and Communication: Collaborate across teams to translate business needs into analytical solutions. Document and communicate research findings, model results, and recommendations to technical and business audiences. Qualifications Master's degree in quantitative finance, statistics or a related quantitative field. Coursework and / or work experience applying predictive modeling techniques from finance, statistics, mathematics, data science, and computer programming to large data sets. Qualifying coursework may include—but is not limited to—statistics, mathematical programming, optimization, machine learning, computational methods, design and analysis of algorithms, Bayesian methods, derivatives, and Monte Carlo methods/modeling. Coursework or experience applying statistical, machine learning, or econometric methods to large datasets. Proficiency in Python, SQL, and Spark for predictive modeling and processing large-scale structured and unstructured data; experience with relational or NoSQL databases. Familiarity with LLMs and GenAI applications, including prompt design, evaluation, or agentic workflows, is a plus. Experience with end-to-end model development; financial services or regulated-industry experience is a plus. Strong problem-solving skills and ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment. Excellent written and verbal communication skills for technical and business audiences. Keys to Success in this Role Technical Contribution: Develop and enhance collateral models and analytical solutions that address business needs and deliver measurable value. Quantitative Research and Data Skills: Apply strong quantitative, empirical analysis, and research skills, supported by hands-on experience processing large volumes of structured and unstructured data. Innovation Mindset: Demonstrate curiosity, initiative, and independent thinking. Learn and apply emerging statistical, machine learning, AI, and data technologies to improve models and development workflows. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Build effective working relationships across teams and contribute constructively to technical discussions and decisions. Clear Communication: Explain complex concepts concisely, communicate research findings effectively, and present a clear project narrative for technical and business audiences. desc: Ready to make your next big professional move? Join us on our journey to achieve our big dream of building the most loved restaurant brands in the world. Restaurant Brands International Inc. is one of the world's largest quick service restaurant companies with nearly $49 billion in annual system-wide sales and over 33,000 restaurants in more than 120 countries and territories. RBI owns four of the world's most prominent and iconic quick service restaurant brands – TIM HORTONS®, BURGER KING®, POPEYES®, and FIREHOUSE SUBS®. These independently operated brands have been serving their respective guests, franchisees and communities for decades. Through its Restaurant Brands for Good framework, RBI is improving sustainable outcomes related to its food, the planet, and people and communities. RBI is committed to growing the TIM HORTONS®, BURGER KING®, POPEYES® and FIREHOUSE SUBS® brands by leveraging their respective core values, employee and franchisee relationships, and long track records of community support. Each brand benefits from the global scale and shared best practices that come from ownership by Restaurant Brands International Inc. Our opportunity: This role uses customer data and advanced analytics to drive measurable business outcomes across CRM, loyalty and personalization. You’ll identify growth opportunities, measure their incremental impact, improve customer targeting and decision-making, and support better executive decisions through automated dashboards and reporting. RBI follows a five-day, in-office work schedule to support collaboration. Candidates should be comfortable working on-site five days per week. Your roles and responsibilities: Drive business outcomes through measurement and experimentation Define methods to measure the incremental impact of customer engagement initiatives, including loyalty, gamification, offers, boosters and challenges, on sales, frequency, retention and customer value. Design A/B and multivariate tests, control groups and uplift analyses to understand which initiatives change customer behavior. Turn test results into clear recommendations on where to invest, what to optimize and what to stop. Turn customer data into growth opportunities Develop customer segmentation and scoring models, including PMIX, product affinity, engagement, lifecycle and customer value. Build propensity, churn, customer lifetime value (CLV) and uplift models to identify customers with the greatest potential for incremental growth. Use analytics to guide targeting, offer strategy, customer investment and prioritization. Enable AI-driven customer decision-making Develop AI and machine learning approaches to identify the most effective offer, message, product or action for each customer. Build Next Best Action frameworks that balance customer relevance with commercial goals, such as incremental sales, margin and retention. Establish feedback loops that improve targeting and personalization based on observed results. Scale insights and support executive decision-making Build automated dashboards and reports that connect customer engagement activity to customer and financial outcomes. Lead executive reporting on incrementality, ROI, retention, frequency, customer value and key growth opportunities. Turn complex data into clear business insights, explaining what happened, why it happened and what action to take. Shape the engagement analytics roadmap Support Product and CRM managers in prioritizing analytical initiatives based on their potential business impact. Help develop the analytics capability from reporting on past performance to predicting customer behavior, recommending actions and improving customer and business value. Your skills & experience: 2–5 years of experience in data analytics or consulting, in a consumer-facing business. Previous experience within QSR industry or in a business franchising business model is an advantage. Previous experience in a regional role, overseeing multiple markets is preferred. Previous experience analyzing CRM and Loyalty data is an advantage. At least a bachelor's degree is required; a quantitative discipline is preferred. Proficient in SQL, Excel, and PowerPoint. Fluent in English. Eligibility to work in Switzerland without work permit sponsorship. Benefits at all of our global offices are focused on physical, mental and financial wellness. We offer unique and progressive benefits, including a comprehensive global paid parental leave program that supports employees as they expand their families, free telemedicine and mental wellness support. RBI's policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment. Accommodation is available for applicants with disabilities upon request.

title: Business Insights & Analytics Analyst
desc: Job Description Purpose of the role To develop, track and analyse operational metrics through trend analysis and client insights, and translate outcomes to support with data driven decisions. Identification of industry trends and developments to implement best practice in analytics and reporting procedures, and controls to mitigate risks and maintain efficient operations. Participation in projects and initiatives to improve analytics and reporting efficiency and effectiveness. Development of reports and presentations on translated data and communicate findings to internal senior stakeholders. Execution of automated trend analysis and client insights, standing good vs bad data, to identify trends, patterns and insights that can inform decision making and process improvements with human feedback. Identification of areas for improvement and providing recommendations for change in analytics and reporting processes. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions. Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. title: Data Engineer

Working alongside industry-leading partners including Microsoft , Databricks , and Autodesk , as well as world-renowned academic institutions such as Cambridge University and Cranfield University , you'll help unlock the value of data to improve project delivery, operational performance, and decision-making across hundreds of capital projects. Managing and optimising enterprise data architecture using Bronze, Silver, and Gold medallion frameworks. Ensuring data quality, accuracy, governance, and traceability across all data assets. Supporting the delivery of reporting and analytics solutions by making trusted data available through centralised platforms. Managing APIs and integrations between key digital systems and platforms. Creating and maintaining technical documentation, data lineage models, architecture diagrams, and metadata standards. Monitoring, troubleshooting, and resolving data-related issues to ensure reliable service delivery. Supporting CI/CD practices and the industrialisation of data products and solutions. Developing proof-of-concept and minimum viable product solutions that help solve business challenges. Working closely with analysts, data scientists, reporting teams, and business stakeholders to deliver value-driven outcomes. Identifying opportunities to improve business performance through innovative uses of data and emerging technologies. About You You'll be an enthusiastic and technically capable data professional who enjoys solving complex problems and turning data into meaningful business insights. To be successful in this role, you'll ideally have: Minimum of 2 years experience in a Data Engineering. Experience designing and developing data pipelines, ETL processes, and data integration solutions. Strong knowledge of Microsoft Azure data services and Databricks. Experience working with data lakes, data warehouses, and modern cloud-based data architectures. Understanding of data modelling, metadata management, data lineage, and data governance principles. Experience using SQL and other relevant data engineering technologies and programming languages. Knowledge of CI/CD principles and best practices within data engineering environments. Experience managing APIs and integrating data across multiple business systems. Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with a focus on data quality and reliability. The ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. A collaborative mindset and a passion for continuous learning and innovation. Why Join Us? You'll benefit from: Personal private health care Life cover – 8x annual salary 26 days holiday plus bank holidays (with flexibility for religious holidays) Flexible working opportunities Competitive pension scheme – we double-match your contributions up to 7% Bonus scheme and a wide range of lifestyle benefits Excellent training and development opportunities The opportunity to work as a recognised Subject Matter Expert in a specialist technical field Ready to Make an Impact? If you're excited by the prospect of building modern data solutions, influencing digital transformation, and helping deliver critical infrastructure for the future, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today and become the next Data Engineer within the @one Alliance Digital, Data and Innovation Team , helping us create smarter, more sustainable ways of delivering for our customers, communities, and environment. title: Machine Learning Engineer
desc:
At Bose Corporation, we believe sound is the most powerful force on earth — and for over 60 years, we have been a company built on innovation, excellence, and independence. Privately owned, fiercely customer-focused, and driven by our values, we continue to lead industries and transform lives through sound. Today, Bose Corporation is entering an exciting new era. Across multiple global Business Units and Global Functions, we are shaping the future of audio technology, automotive, luxury, and premium experiences. We invite you to join us in this transformation. Job Description About the Role Bose is seeking a Machine Learning Engineer with expertise in Efficient AI and Edge ML to join our team. In this role, you will design, train, optimize, and deploy machine learning models for next-generation audio products. You will work closely with embedded, DSP, compiler, hardware, and software engineers to bring AI capabilities to resource-constrained devices. The ideal candidate has strong machine learning fundamentals, practical experience with efficient model development, and an understanding of Edge ML deployment constraints. Deep embedded systems expertise is not required. However, you should be able to understand deployment and integration feedback, identify model-related limitations, and quickly iterate on model architectures and training methods to improve accuracy, latency, memory usage, and power efficiency. Responsibilities Design, train, evaluate, and optimize machine learning models for consumer audio products. Apply Efficient ML techniques, including quantization, pruning, knowledge distillation, model compression, and efficient model architectures, to improve model efficiency while maintaining model quality. Work closely with embedded, DSP, compiler, and hardware engineers to deploy and integrate machine learning models on resource-constrained platforms, including DSPs, NPUs, microcontrollers, and ARM-based systems. Analyze deployment and integration feedback, identify model-related issues, and rapidly iterate on model architectures and training methodologies. Adapt models to address platform constraints such as unsupported operators, data-type limitations, memory usage, latency, compute requirements, and power consumption. Profile and evaluate model performance across accuracy, latency, memory footprint, model size, compute efficiency, and power usage. Develop and maintain repeatable workflows for model training, conversion, compilation, simulation, validation, and performance analysis. Collaborate across Machine Learning, embedded software, DSP, hardware, compiler, and product engineering teams to deliver production-ready AI solutions. Evaluate emerging ML technologies and AI-assisted engineering tools that can improve model development, deployment, debugging, and optimization workflows. Document experiments, technical findings, deployment learnings, and reusable engineering practices. Mentor interns and co-op engineers. Minimum Qualifications M.S. or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Machine Learning, or a related field. Strong foundation in machine learning and deep learning, including model architecture design, training, evaluation, and optimization. Working knowledge of Efficient ML techniques such as quantization, pruning, knowledge distillation, model compression, and efficient model architectures. Understanding of how model optimization techniques affect model accuracy, latency, memory footprint, compute requirements, and deployment compatibility. Proficiency with deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or similar. Strong Python programming, debugging, and problem-solving skills. Working knowledge of C/C++ and the ability to collaborate effectively with engineers working on embedded and production systems. Understanding of Edge ML concepts and common resource constraints, including computation, memory, latency, and power. Ability to analyze model behavior and troubleshoot issues across training, conversion, deployment, and integration workflows. Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills. Preferred Qualifications Hands-on experience with quantization-aware training, post-training quantization, mixed-precision inference, structured or unstructured pruning, operator replacement, or hardware-aware model optimization. Experience adapting model architectures or training workflows in response to deployment and integration constraints. Experience deploying machine learning models on edge devices, DSPs, NPUs, mobile platforms, wearable devices, or other resource-constrained systems. Familiarity with deployment frameworks and toolchains such as TensorFlow Lite, TensorFlow Lite Micro, ONNX Runtime, TVM, MLIR, or vendor-specific SDKs. Understanding of deployment and performance metrics such as latency, memory footprint, model size, MACs, memory bandwidth, and power consumption. Experience with audio ML, speech processing, acoustic sensing, or multimodal models involving audio. Familiarity with LLM- or agent-based engineering workflows, including knowledge retrieval, tool calling, technical documentation analysis, structured data extraction, failure diagnosis, benchmark analysis, or optimization recommendations. Experience building or evaluating AI-assisted tools that improve ML development, deployment, debugging, or engineering productivity. Curiosity about the interaction between machine learning models, software toolchains, and hardware platforms. #LI-Hybrid At Bose, you're inspired to be and do your best and are rewarded for your unique talents! Our compensation is thoughtfully tailored to your skills, experience, education, and location, and goes beyond base salary. The hiring range for this position in the primary work location of Framingham, Massachusetts is: $141,000-$193,950.The hiring range for other Bose work locations may vary.

In addition to competitive base pay we offer rewards including bonus programs, comprehensive health and welfare benefits, a 401(k) plan, plus exclusive perks designed to support your wellbeing, and a generous employee discount where you can immerse yourself in our products and experiences. We are a proudly independent company—driven by purpose, guided by our values, and united by a belief in the power of sound. As the world leader in audio experiences, we’re creating what’s next—pushing boundaries and delivering transformative sound experiences for people everywhere. Join us and make your next career move a mic-drop. Let’s Make Waves. ‎

title: Research Associate I
desc: Current Employees: If you are a current Staff, Faculty or Temporary employee at the University of Miami, please click here to log in to Workday to use the internal application process. To learn how to apply for a faculty or staff position, please review this tip sheet . Coral Recruit Technician – Research Associate I Coral Reef Futures Lab The Coral Recruit Technician is an integral part of the University of Miami’s Land-Based Coral Facility team at The Rosenstiel School on Virginia Key, FL. This position supports reef research and restoration conducted by the Coral Reef Futures Lab. Specifically, the coral recruit technician carries out the sexual propagation and subsequent care of Caribbean coral juveniles within the lab’s aquaculture facility and research spaces. This is a key period in coral development during which the employee’s attention to detail, drive, and determination contribute directly to the production and survival of coral recruits. Key Responsibilities: Assist with the production, rearing, and outplanting of sexually derived coral recruits Perform daily husbandry and maintain aquarium systems. Monitor coral health to identify and address issues as they arise. Coordinate daily and weekly husbandry activities, including developing and assigning tasks to student volunteers. Must adhere to and instruct based on standard operating procedures for coral systems. Assist with the diagnosis and resolution of plumbing, electrical, and other operational issues associated with aquarium systems. Coordinate with graduate students and other staff in the Coral Reef Futures Lab to support ongoing research efforts. Respond as a team member to system equipment failures in an on-call capacity, with the ability to think critically to diagnose and resolve issues in coordination with other team members. Participate in evening and nighttime coral spawning, fertilization, and larval care activities, with occasional work schedule changes to work on weekends or public holidays to accommodate these activities during the spawning season. Requirements & qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in marine biology, environmental science, or a related field (or equivalent experience). U.S. citizenship, or valid U.S. work authorization. Knowledge of coral biology, aquaculture, marine science, and/or related fields. Strong organizational and interpersonal skills. Ability to communicate effectively and professionally with team members, researchers, and members of the public. Accountability and attention to detail, particularly when working with living organisms and time-sensitive husbandry needs. Ability to troubleshoot and communicate or delegate tasks effectively. Ability to work for several hours a day in outdoor shadehouse facilities in South Florida, which can be particularly warm and humid during the summer. Preferred qualifications/competencies: Experience with coral spawning and rearing sexually derived coral recruits Experience with saltwater aquaria, coral husbandry, life support systems, and/or water quality AAUS Scientific Diving certification MOCC Boating certification Work Environment: Although this position includes work with indoor systems, laboratories, and spawning tanks, most time will be spent at the outdoor land-based coral facility. Additional opportunities exist to support field efforts. South Florida weather can be unpredictable and at times extreme, and consequently sun-protective clothing and head coverage via sunhat or hooded shirt are required. Employees should be prepared to work up to 4-5 hours at a time outdoors, and on occasion outside of the regular work week, being accountable for responding to equipment alerts, and involvement in nighttime spawning activities. Position occasionally involves physically demanding duties, including lifting and transporting items weighing up to 50 pounds. The University of Miami is recognized as one of the nation’s premier research institutions and academic health systems and is among the largest employers in South Florida. With more than 20,000 faculty and staff, the University is committed to excellence and guided by a mission to positively impact the lives of students, patients, and communities locally and globally. We are dedicated to fostering a culture where every individual feels valued and empowered to contribute meaningfully. United by shared values, the University community works together to build an environment defined by purpose, collaboration, and service. The University of Miami
